physical.note: Closed failed/stopped worlds retain their physical observations but are not paired as completed runs. First/threshold stages select exact unique positive source receipts, never last authorization or an acknowledgement.

nativeSummary.note: Declared experimental staffing and work durations, not empirical human performance. Person-ms counts attention work or waiting, not wages or productivity. Percentiles exclude pending work; pending counts and cutoff are reported separately. Work receipt/relay/owner approval never counts as physical aid. Attention lapses are explicit inconclusive outcomes, not invented false facts.

human.note: Native stage/backlog/person-ms includes source background work. Received tasks use latest versions, not every historical snapshot. Pending work remains censored; no task/relay/review is physical aid. Raw payload/text/private snapshots are not copied.

definitions.time: Local review/audit wall-clock timestamps and source physical clocks are separate; never subtract or sum them.
definitions.denominator: All stored owner-scoped proposals and exact historical local review decisions; not only successful/completed plans. Delegated copies remain identified separately.
definitions.service: Positive independently recorded physical receipt of the exact issued delivery/evacuation. Receipt positivity is not marginal deficit reduction: redundant delivered supply can satisfy this contract. Payment, provision, assessment and activation alone get no positive-receipt credit.
definitions.legacyAliases: Deprecated usefulPhysicalService, usefulServiceProposals, partialUsefulServiceProposals, uniqueUsefulSourceOperations, completedWithoutDirectUsefulService and usefulPerReviewedProposal mean positive linked receipt presence/quantity, not aid benefit or deficit reduction. Use positivePhysicalService / uniquePositivePhysicalSourceOperations for receipt counts and native deficit/outcome metrics for benefit; no quantity is silently clamped here.
definitions.duplicates: A source operation may support coordinator and delegated review scopes. Unique owner+sourceID physical receipts are reported separately and never summed twice.
definitions.limits: Internal scripted review and post-execution attribution are mechanisms; these ratios do not measure human comprehension, correctness of unseen semantic claims or field effectiveness.

profiler.note: Host instrumentation only; no measured SQL/HTTP duration is used to advance physical time. Store-query counts exclude internal transaction-client calls. All owners use the same instrumentation.

rows.note: Completed recovered-error worlds remain eligible if sources, physical evidence and protocol match. Errors/costs are retained; no success-only source selection.

physical.note: Closed failed/stopped worlds retain their physical observations but are not paired as completed runs. First/threshold stages select exact unique positive source receipts, never last authorization or an acknowledgement.

nativeSummary.note: Declared experimental staffing and work durations, not empirical human performance. Person-ms counts attention work or waiting, not wages or productivity. Percentiles exclude pending work; pending counts and cutoff are reported separately. Work receipt/relay/owner approval never counts as physical aid. Attention lapses are explicit inconclusive outcomes, not invented false facts.

human.note: Native stage/backlog/person-ms includes source background work. Received tasks use latest versions, not every historical snapshot. Pending work remains censored; no task/relay/review is physical aid. Raw payload/text/private snapshots are not copied.

definitions.time: Local review/audit wall-clock timestamps and source physical clocks are separate; never subtract or sum them.
definitions.denominator: All stored owner-scoped proposals and exact historical local review decisions; not only successful/completed plans. Delegated copies remain identified separately.
definitions.service: Positive independently recorded physical receipt of the exact issued delivery/evacuation. Receipt positivity is not marginal deficit reduction: redundant delivered supply can satisfy this contract. Payment, provision, assessment and activation alone get no positive-receipt credit.
definitions.legacyAliases: Deprecated usefulPhysicalService, usefulServiceProposals, partialUsefulServiceProposals, uniqueUsefulSourceOperations, completedWithoutDirectUsefulService and usefulPerReviewedProposal mean positive linked receipt presence/quantity, not aid benefit or deficit reduction. Use positivePhysicalService / uniquePositivePhysicalSourceOperations for receipt counts and native deficit/outcome metrics for benefit; no quantity is silently clamped here.
definitions.duplicates: A source operation may support coordinator and delegated review scopes. Unique owner+sourceID physical receipts are reported separately and never summed twice.
definitions.limits: Internal scripted review and post-execution attribution are mechanisms; these ratios do not measure human comprehension, correctness of unseen semantic claims or field effectiveness.

profiler.note: Host instrumentation only; no measured SQL/HTTP duration is used to advance physical time. Store-query counts exclude internal transaction-client calls. All owners use the same instrumentation.

rows.note: Completed recovered-error worlds remain eligible if sources, physical evidence and protocol match. Errors/costs are retained; no success-only source selection.

cost.note: Known subtotals are not total bills when usage is missing. A reserved cap is exposure, not an invented charge. SQL/CPU wall, infrastructure and human wages are separate.

firstUseful.note: Restricted mean/percentiles retain right-censored cases at their declared observation horizon. Reached-only p95 excludes censored cases and must be read with coverage.

definitions.time: Local review/audit wall-clock timestamps and source physical clocks are separate; never subtract or sum them.
definitions.denominator: All stored owner-scoped proposals and exact historical local review decisions; not only successful/completed plans. Delegated copies remain identified separately.
definitions.service: Positive independently recorded physical receipt of the exact issued delivery/evacuation. Receipt positivity is not marginal deficit reduction: redundant delivered supply can satisfy this contract. Payment, provision, assessment and activation alone get no positive-receipt credit.
definitions.legacyAliases: Deprecated usefulPhysicalService, usefulServiceProposals, partialUsefulServiceProposals, uniqueUsefulSourceOperations, completedWithoutDirectUsefulService and usefulPerReviewedProposal mean positive linked receipt presence/quantity, not aid benefit or deficit reduction. Use positivePhysicalService / uniquePositivePhysicalSourceOperations for receipt counts and native deficit/outcome metrics for benefit; no quantity is silently clamped here.
definitions.duplicates: A source operation may support coordinator and delegated review scopes. Unique owner+sourceID physical receipts are reported separately and never summed twice.
definitions.limits: Internal scripted review and post-execution attribution are mechanisms; these ratios do not measure human comprehension, correctness of unseen semantic claims or field effectiveness.

physical.note: Closed failed/stopped worlds retain their physical observations but are not paired as completed runs. First/threshold stages select exact unique positive source receipts, never last authorization or an acknowledgement.

nativeSummary.note: Declared experimental staffing and work durations, not empirical human performance. Person-ms counts attention work or waiting, not wages or productivity. Percentiles exclude pending work; pending counts and cutoff are reported separately. Work receipt/relay/owner approval never counts as physical aid. Attention lapses are explicit inconclusive outcomes, not invented false facts.

human.note: Native stage/backlog/person-ms includes source background work. Received tasks use latest versions, not every historical snapshot. Pending work remains censored; no task/relay/review is physical aid. Raw payload/text/private snapshots are not copied.

definitions.time: Local review/audit wall-clock timestamps and source physical clocks are separate; never subtract or sum them.
definitions.denominator: All stored owner-scoped proposals and exact historical local review decisions; not only successful/completed plans. Delegated copies remain identified separately.
definitions.service: Positive independently recorded physical receipt of the exact issued delivery/evacuation. Receipt positivity is not marginal deficit reduction: redundant delivered supply can satisfy this contract. Payment, provision, assessment and activation alone get no positive-receipt credit.
definitions.legacyAliases: Deprecated usefulPhysicalService, usefulServiceProposals, partialUsefulServiceProposals, uniqueUsefulSourceOperations, completedWithoutDirectUsefulService and usefulPerReviewedProposal mean positive linked receipt presence/quantity, not aid benefit or deficit reduction. Use positivePhysicalService / uniquePositivePhysicalSourceOperations for receipt counts and native deficit/outcome metrics for benefit; no quantity is silently clamped here.
definitions.duplicates: A source operation may support coordinator and delegated review scopes. Unique owner+sourceID physical receipts are reported separately and never summed twice.
definitions.limits: Internal scripted review and post-execution attribution are mechanisms; these ratios do not measure human comprehension, correctness of unseen semantic claims or field effectiveness.

profiler.note: Host instrumentation only; no measured SQL/HTTP duration is used to advance physical time. Store-query counts exclude internal transaction-client calls. All owners use the same instrumentation.

rows.note: Completed recovered-error worlds remain eligible if sources, physical evidence and protocol match. Errors/costs are retained; no success-only source selection.

cost.note: Known subtotals are not total bills when usage is missing. A reserved cap is exposure, not an invented charge. SQL/CPU wall, infrastructure and human wages are separate.

physical.note: Closed failed/stopped worlds retain their physical observations but are not paired as completed runs. First/threshold stages select exact unique positive source receipts, never last authorization or an acknowledgement.

nativeSummary.note: Declared experimental staffing and work durations, not empirical human performance. Person-ms counts attention work or waiting, not wages or productivity. Percentiles exclude pending work; pending counts and cutoff are reported separately. Work receipt/relay/owner approval never counts as physical aid. Attention lapses are explicit inconclusive outcomes, not invented false facts.

human.note: Native stage/backlog/person-ms includes source background work. Received tasks use latest versions, not every historical snapshot. Pending work remains censored; no task/relay/review is physical aid. Raw payload/text/private snapshots are not copied.

definitions.time: Local review/audit wall-clock timestamps and source physical clocks are separate; never subtract or sum them.
definitions.denominator: All stored owner-scoped proposals and exact historical local review decisions; not only successful/completed plans. Delegated copies remain identified separately.
definitions.service: Positive independently recorded physical receipt of the exact issued delivery/evacuation. Receipt positivity is not marginal deficit reduction: redundant delivered supply can satisfy this contract. Payment, provision, assessment and activation alone get no positive-receipt credit.
definitions.legacyAliases: Deprecated usefulPhysicalService, usefulServiceProposals, partialUsefulServiceProposals, uniqueUsefulSourceOperations, completedWithoutDirectUsefulService and usefulPerReviewedProposal mean positive linked receipt presence/quantity, not aid benefit or deficit reduction. Use positivePhysicalService / uniquePositivePhysicalSourceOperations for receipt counts and native deficit/outcome metrics for benefit; no quantity is silently clamped here.
definitions.duplicates: A source operation may support coordinator and delegated review scopes. Unique owner+sourceID physical receipts are reported separately and never summed twice.
definitions.limits: Internal scripted review and post-execution attribution are mechanisms; these ratios do not measure human comprehension, correctness of unseen semantic claims or field effectiveness.

profiler.note: Host instrumentation only; no measured SQL/HTTP duration is used to advance physical time. Store-query counts exclude internal transaction-client calls. All owners use the same instrumentation.

rows.note: Completed recovered-error worlds remain eligible if sources, physical evidence and protocol match. Errors/costs are retained; no success-only source selection.

cost.note: Known subtotals are not total bills when usage is missing. A reserved cap is exposure, not an invented charge. SQL/CPU wall, infrastructure and human wages are separate.

physical.note: Closed failed/stopped worlds retain their physical observations but are not paired as completed runs. First/threshold stages select exact unique positive source receipts, never last authorization or an acknowledgement.

nativeSummary.note: Declared experimental staffing and work durations, not empirical human performance. Person-ms counts attention work or waiting, not wages or productivity. Percentiles exclude pending work; pending counts and cutoff are reported separately. Work receipt/relay/owner approval never counts as physical aid. Attention lapses are explicit inconclusive outcomes, not invented false facts.

human.note: Native stage/backlog/person-ms includes source background work. Received tasks use latest versions, not every historical snapshot. Pending work remains censored; no task/relay/review is physical aid. Raw payload/text/private snapshots are not copied.

definitions.time: Local review/audit wall-clock timestamps and source physical clocks are separate; never subtract or sum them.
definitions.denominator: All stored owner-scoped proposals and exact historical local review decisions; not only successful/completed plans. Delegated copies remain identified separately.
definitions.service: Positive independently recorded physical receipt of the exact issued delivery/evacuation. Receipt positivity is not marginal deficit reduction: redundant delivered supply can satisfy this contract. Payment, provision, assessment and activation alone get no positive-receipt credit.
definitions.legacyAliases: Deprecated usefulPhysicalService, usefulServiceProposals, partialUsefulServiceProposals, uniqueUsefulSourceOperations, completedWithoutDirectUsefulService and usefulPerReviewedProposal mean positive linked receipt presence/quantity, not aid benefit or deficit reduction. Use positivePhysicalService / uniquePositivePhysicalSourceOperations for receipt counts and native deficit/outcome metrics for benefit; no quantity is silently clamped here.
definitions.duplicates: A source operation may support coordinator and delegated review scopes. Unique owner+sourceID physical receipts are reported separately and never summed twice.
definitions.limits: Internal scripted review and post-execution attribution are mechanisms; these ratios do not measure human comprehension, correctness of unseen semantic claims or field effectiveness.

nativeSummary.note: Declared experimental staffing and work durations, not empirical human performance. Person-ms counts attention work or waiting, not wages or productivity. human.note: Native stage/backlog/person-ms includes source background work. Received tasks use latest versions, not every historical snapshot. Pending work remains censored; no task/relay/review is physical aid. Raw payload/text/private snapshots are not copied.

definitions.time: Local review/audit wall-clock timestamps and source physical clocks are separate; never subtract or sum them.
definitions.denominator: All stored owner-scoped proposals and exact historical local review decisions; not only successful/completed plans. Delegated copies remain identified separately.
definitions.service: Positive independently recorded physical receipt of the exact issued delivery/evacuation. Receipt positivity is not marginal deficit reduction: redundant delivered supply can satisfy this contract. Payment, provision, assessment and activation alone get no positive-receipt credit.
definitions.legacyAliases: Deprecated usefulPhysicalService, usefulServiceProposals, partialUsefulServiceProposals, uniqueUsefulSourceOperations, completedWithoutDirectUsefulService and usefulPerReviewedProposal mean positive linked receipt presence/quantity, not aid benefit or deficit reduction. Use positivePhysicalService / uniquePositivePhysicalSourceOperations for receipt counts and native deficit/outcome metrics for benefit; no quantity is silently clamped here.
definitions.duplicates: A source operation may support coordinator and delegated review scopes. Unique owner+sourceID physical receipts are reported separately and never summed twice.
definitions.limits: Internal scripted review and post-execution attribution are mechanisms; these ratios do not measure human comprehension, correctness of unseen semantic claims or field effectiveness.

profiler.note: Host instrumentation only; no measured SQL/HTTP duration is used to advance physical time. Store-query counts exclude internal transaction-client calls. All owners use the same instrumentation.

rows.note: Completed recovered-error worlds remain eligible if sources, physical evidence and protocol match. Errors/costs are retained; no success-only source selection.

cost.note: Known subtotals are not total bills when usage is missing. A reserved cap is exposure, not an invented charge. SQL/CPU wall, infrastructure and human wages are separate.

firstUseful.note: Restricted mean/percentiles retain right-censored cases at their declared observation horizon. Reached-only p95 excludes censored cases and must be read with coverage.

physical.note: Closed failed/stopped worlds retain their physical observations but are not paired as completed runs. First/threshold stages select exact unique positive source receipts, never last authorization or an acknowledgement.

nativeSummary.note: Declared experimental staffing and work durations, not empirical human performance. Person-ms counts attention work or waiting, not wages or productivity. Percentiles exclude pending work; pending counts and cutoff are reported separately. Work receipt/relay/owner approval never counts as physical aid. Attention lapses are explicit inconclusive outcomes, not invented false facts.

human.note: Native stage/backlog/person-ms includes source background work. Received tasks use latest versions, not every historical snapshot. Pending work remains censored; no task/relay/review is physical aid. Raw payload/text/private snapshots are not copied.

definitions.time: Local review/audit wall-clock timestamps and source physical clocks are separate; never subtract or sum them.
definitions.denominator: All stored owner-scoped proposals and exact historical local review decisions; not only successful/completed plans. Delegated copies remain identified separately.
definitions.service: Positive independently recorded physical receipt of the exact issued delivery/evacuation. Receipt positivity is not marginal deficit reduction: redundant delivered supply can satisfy this contract. Payment, provision, assessment and activation alone get no positive-receipt credit.
definitions.legacyAliases: Deprecated usefulPhysicalService, usefulServiceProposals, partialUsefulServiceProposals, uniqueUsefulSourceOperations, completedWithoutDirectUsefulService and usefulPerReviewedProposal mean positive linked receipt presence/quantity, not aid benefit or deficit reduction. Use positivePhysicalService / uniquePositivePhysicalSourceOperations for receipt counts and native deficit/outcome metrics for benefit; no quantity is silently clamped here.
definitions.duplicates: A source operation may support coordinator and delegated review scopes. Unique owner+sourceID physical receipts are reported separately and never summed twice.
definitions.limits: Internal scripted review and post-execution attribution are mechanisms; these ratios do not measure human comprehension, correctness of unseen semantic claims or field effectiveness.

profiler.note: Host instrumentation only; no measured SQL/HTTP duration is used to advance physical time. Store-query counts exclude internal transaction-client calls. All owners use the same instrumentation.

rows.note: Completed recovered-error worlds remain eligible if sources, physical evidence and protocol match. Errors/costs are retained; no success-only source selection.

cost.note: Known subtotals are not total bills when usage is missing. A reserved cap is exposure, not an invented charge. SQL/CPU wall, infrastructure and human wages are separate.

physical.note: Closed failed/stopped worlds retain their physical observations but are not paired as completed runs. First/threshold stages select exact unique positive source receipts, never last authorization or an acknowledgement.

nativeSummary.note: Declared experimental staffing and work durations, not empirical human performance. Person-ms counts attention work or waiting, not wages or productivity. Percentiles exclude pending work; pending counts and cutoff are reported separately. Work receipt/relay/owner approval never counts as physical aid. Attention lapses are explicit inconclusive outcomes, not invented false facts.

human.note: Native stage/backlog/person-ms includes source background work. Received tasks use latest versions, not every historical snapshot. Pending work remains censored; no task/relay/review is physical aid. Raw payload/text/private snapshots are not copied.

reviews.note: Scripted laboratory operator; not a human UX trial.

steps.note: A positive linked physical receipt requires the exact owner/action/operation and an independent positive service receipt. It may be redundant supply; this funnel does not compute marginal deficit reduction. Issued IDs, proposal completion, assessment, payment, provisioning or arrival alone do not qualify.
